# Refinancing / First Meridian Credit Facility

- **Goal / definition of done:** cure the **Q2 2026 breach of the net-leverage covenant
  (≤ 3.5x)** on the **$120M revolving facility**, secure a **waiver**, and ideally an
  amend-and-extend that resets covenants against a credible margin-recovery plan.
- **Owner:** [Priya Deshmukh](../people/priya-deshmukh.md) (CFO); lender contact is
  [Ellen Marsh](../people/ellen-marsh.md) at First Meridian Bank.
- **Status:** waiver in process; the bank wants the margin-recovery plan
  ([OEE program](operational-excellence.md) + [Slate](slate.md), the latter shared only in
  de-identified terms) attached. The **signed waiver letter back to First Meridian is overdue**.
- **Why it matters:** the facility funds working capital; a covenant default would be existential.

## Open items
- Sign and return the covenant-waiver letter — **overdue** (see [commitments](../commitments.md)).
- Attach the finalized margin-recovery plan to the amend-and-extend request.
